outputs.without:
Dear valued readers,

We're excited to announce a new shift for you! Sunday opening will move to 10 am on October 6, 2023. This change is designed to accommodate shift workers and provide a seamless experience for all.

We hope to see you soon!
outputs.with:
**Subject:** Shift Workers: Sunday Opening Time Changes to 10 AM

**Body:** On October 6, shift workers will be able to start their shifts at 10 AM. This change is a welcome move that will benefit many, especially those working irregular hours. We encourage all readers to drop in and experience the new opening time. Thank you for your support!
